sectors.trend: Coal and LNG outperform; iron ore weak. Rare earths and critical minerals (antimony, phosphate, uranium) see multiple project milestones. Gold explorers active in WA and VIC.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face iron ore headwinds. Coal names (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) benefit from Middle East-driven oil/energy complex. Small-cap miners (LND.AX, BKY.AX, AGU.AX, INF.AX, KSR.AX, LRV.AX) gain on policy tailwinds.

sectors.trend: Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes. Macquarie Group audit bid raises governance questions. Banks under pressure from housing slump and inflation.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM compression risk. MCG.AX governance overhang. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by falling property values and renter relief.

sectors.trend: Oil surges on US-Iran flare-up; diesel shock persists. Wind farm pipeline revived by Danish entrant. Gas reservation policy under attack.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX, SXW.AX benefit from oil/coal strength. Renewable developers (SOL.AX, LEM.AX) gain on wind farm catalyst. Downstream refiners face margin pressure.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs US price-cut deal with Trump administration; MND research advances. Weight-loss drug demand surging domestically.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX short-term positive on deal visibility but long-term margin risk from price compression. CSL.AX, SVL.AX, OSH.AX monitor US pricing policy spillover.

sectors.trend: Qantas strike vote creates operational risk. EV uptake accelerating. Dupe brands and weight-loss drugs signal shifting consumer behaviour. Retail closures continue.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces strike disruption risk. Consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) see mixed signals. EV supply chain names benefit.

sectors.trend: Central bank warns AI could trigger global downturn. AI power demand reshaping industrials. Meta settlement and social media ban loom.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global risk-off sentiment spills over. CAT.AX (US) as proxy for AI capex cycle. Monitor ^AXJO tech sub-index.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Brent/WTI; favour coal/LNG over oil-exposed names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing slump and property developer distress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; favour banks with strong capital buffers
Monitor CPI components; favour inflation-hedged assets (commodities, gold)
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor travel/airline sector sentiment
Diversify across sectors; monitor global central bank commentary
Maintain cash allocation; favour short-duration fixed income

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and LNG names on Middle East-driven energy complex
opportunities.rationale: Oil surge and diesel shock support thermal coal and LNG pricing; WDS.AX, LSE.AX, SXW.AX benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals / rare earths pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple project milestones (Lindian, Barkly, Aguia, Infini) signal policy-driven capital inflows into ASX small-caps

opportunities.recommendation: CSL.AX tactical buy on US deal visibility
opportunities.rationale: US price-cut deal provides revenue certainty; short-term catalyst despite long-term margin compression

opportunities.recommendation: Gold exposure as inflation and geopolitical hedge
opportunities.rationale: Home-grown inflation plus Middle East tensions support gold; WA/VIC explorers offer leverage

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney house price crash, credit growth collapse, and Bathla distress signal sector-wide deterioration
Iron ore under pressure; coal/energy complex outperforming; BHP/RIO/FMG face margin headwinds
Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty
Global debt spiral, AI contagion risk, and Middle East tensions elevate tail risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Oil volatility, housing slump, and home-grown inflation constrain upside. CSL.AX and energy names provide pockets of strength. RBA on hold or cautious easing given sticky domestic inflation. AUD/USD likely soft on risk-off flows.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA eases and housing stabilises. Critical minerals and energy transition themes offer structural growth. Iron ore recovery dependent on China stimulus. AI disruption remains a wildcard for global growth and equity valuations.
